name: Dr. Dhyanpal Singh Memorial Award (for Final-Year Undergraduate Students of All Colleges)
benefit: The selected students will receive an amount of ₹30,000/- per year in their final year of undergraduate.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the final year of an undergraduate course at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The award amount is provided once per year.
